name: No Boss PMCs
teaser: Simply removes boss brains from the PMC brain pool
description_html:

THIS MOD IS NOT COMPATIBLE WITH SAIN

This is a very simple mod that removes all boss brains from PMCs, and makes them only utilize BSGs PMC AI. This should help reduce the amount of times you get shot from extreme distances, and other strange behaviour generally only associated with bosses.

  • All PMCs now only have a single brain choice (pmcBEAR for bear, pmcUSEC for usec)
  • Player scavs choose randomly between pmcBEAR, pmcUSEC, or assault

But why does SPT include boss brains in PMCs?

Prior to BSG adding PvE, there was no PMC AI in Tarkov. This meant that for variety and difficulty, SPT needed to use boss brains to “fill in the gaps”.

Modern versions of SPT still utilize boss brains to give variety, and a sense of running into more challenging opponents. However some users find these encounters frustrating, which is why I’ve made this mod.

Installation

1) Open the downloaded zip file in 7-zip

2) Select the folder in the zip file in 7-zip

3) Drag the selected folder from 7-zip into your SPT folder
